pipeline.inspectNotes: Bead attribution-classifier ack: commit d1e8cb6f25 (fix(costs): add no-issue attribution classifier) satisfies all 4 acceptance criteria — classifySessionBucket returns FLYWHEEL for a matched flywheel-orchestrator conversation (AC1), CONVERSATIONS for any other matched conversation via sessionId or conv-* agentId (AC2), UNATTRIBUTED (never UNKNOWN) on no match (AC3); findConversationForCostSessionSync matches conversation_files.locator=sessionId and conversations.tmux_session=agentId for conv-* prefixes, returning null when absent (AC4). Verified via git show d1e8cb6f25 diff plus a live run of npx vitest run src/lib/costs/__tests__/attribution.test.ts at current HEAD — 5/5 pass. Confirmed the function was later relocated to src/lib/overdeck/conversation-cost-session.ts and re-exported from conversations.ts by unrelated commit d162c89a93 without behavior change. This supersedes the earlier BLOCKED verdict, which was posted against the wrong commit (8d5f3d5209, a delivery routing mismatch).
